items.note: INTACH Annexure 1 inventory, rows 1-9: hill fortress wall (10th c., unprotected, poor), Jain cave (6th c.), Hindu sculptures and Jind baba mazar, and gates Chanderi Darwaza, Moti Masjid Darwaza, Purani Basti Darwaza (11th c.), with condition grades and GPS.
Inventory rows 9-18: gates, Raja Mahal (palace, 11th c., State Administration, poor), chhatris, Barah Khambi (ASI, good, grade I*), Purana Bazaar precinct.

Inventory rows 18-26: Neellanchershwar Mandir (11th c., ASI, very good, I*), Bija Mandal Mandir (unprotected, poor), Pisanhari Mandir (State Archaeological Department), Hezaria Mahadev and other temples with protection status.
Inventory rows 26-30: Nav Durga, Dudhiye Bhairav, Tulsi Mahadev, Ravan Tol and Ganesh temples listed, 11th century, mostly unprotected.

Inventory rows 31-40: Shiv temple, Badi Main Mandir (16th c.), Ravine Tol Chaturbhuji Shiva (State Archaeological Department), Jain Mandir (18th c.), and mosques Jah Bakesh (16th c.), Moorhali, Moti Masjid (18th c.), Shahi Masjid (17th c.).

Inventory rows 38-48: Shahi Masjid, a mausoleum, residential havelis (Dunlat Rai Matheri Haveli, Madhuk Seth ka Ghar), Singhpur, Udaysagar lake ruins, Puttal Baoli, Sambhu ji ki Baoli, Setho ki Banjya Baoli.
Inventory rows 47-51: Setho ki Banjya Baoli (very good, grade I), Ghad Dod Baoli (17th c.), Tulai Mahadev Baoli, and Karna Kaa well (11th c.).

reject_reason: annexure headings and picture captions only; no content

items.note: Lajja Gauri petroglyph on the eastern side of the middle hill, 60x55 cm on red sandstone, claimed as the first such petroglyph found in Central India.
Report says the figure with a head is not found elsewhere; Lajja Gauri usually appears headless, and this one is carved in more detail.
